run_googletest_output_test: run the googletest output test to verify Google Test text output matches the golden file
generate_googletest_golden_file: generate the googletest golden file by running all commands with the --gengolden flag
normalize_test_output: normalize googletest output by removing file locations, stack traces, and time information
remove_stack_traces: remove all stack trace details from a Google Test program output using regex substitution
remove_matching_tests: remove output of specified test cases from Google Test output by matching a regex pattern
